mapper.select: WITH cfg AS ( SELECT NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'IDEAL_MIN_SCORE' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 70) AS MIN_SCORE, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_SMOKING' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 3) AS W_SMOKING, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_DRINKING' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 2) AS W_DRINKING, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_RELIGION' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 2) AS W_RELIGION, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_HEIGHT' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 2) AS W_HEIGHT, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_MBTI' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 1) AS W_MBTI, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_WEIGHT' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 1) AS W_WEIGHT, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_FACE_TYPE' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 1) AS W_FACE, NVL(MAX(CASE CONFIG_KEY WHEN 'W_SKIN_TYPE' THEN TO_NUMBER(CONFIG_VALUE) END), 1) AS W_SKIN FROM SYS_MATCHING_CONFIG ), cand AS ( SELECT q.MEMBER_SEQ FROM MATCH_QUEUE q JOIN MEMBER m ON m.MEMBER_SEQ = q.MEMBER_SEQ JOIN MEMBER_IDEAL i ON i.MEMBER_SEQ = q.MEMBER_SEQ JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE p ON p.MEMBER_SEQ = q.MEMBER_SEQ JOIN MEMBER me ON me.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} JOIN MEMBER_IDEAL mi ON mi.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} WHERE q.MATCH_TYPE = 'IDEAL' AND q.STATUS = 'WAITING' AND q.MEMBER_SEQ <> #{memberSeq} AND m.MEMBER_STATUS = 'ACTIVE' AND m.GENDER <> me.GENDER AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, m.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) BETWEEN mi.IDEAL_AGE_MIN AND mi.IDEAL_AGE_MAX AND TRUNC(MONTHS_BETWEEN(SYSDATE, me.BIRTH_DATE) / 12) BETWEEN i.IDEAL_AGE_MIN AND i.IDEAL_AGE_MAX AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM MEMBER_BLOCK b WHERE (b.MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND b.BLOCKED_MEMBER_SEQ = q.MEMBER_SEQ) OR (b.MEMBER_SEQ = q.MEMBER_SEQ AND b.BLOCKED_MEMBER_SEQ = #{memberSeq})) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM IDEAL_MATCHING im WHERE ((im.MEMBER_SEQ_1 = #{memberSeq} AND im.MEMBER_SEQ_2 = q.MEMBER_SEQ) OR (im.MEMBER_SEQ_1 = q.MEMBER_SEQ AND im.MEMBER_SEQ_2 = #{memberSeq})) AND im.MATCHED_AT > SYSTIMESTAMP - INTERVAL '7' DAY) ), dir AS ( SELECT #{memberSeq} AS FROM_SEQ, MEMBER_SEQ AS TO_SEQ FROM cand UNION ALL SELECT MEMBER_SEQ, #{memberSeq} FROM cand ), item AS ( SELECT d.FROM_SEQ, d.TO_SEQ, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_SMOKING <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_SMOKING ELSE 0 END AS A_SMOKING, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_SMOKING || ',', ',' || tp.SMOKING || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_SMOKING, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_DRINKING <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_DRINKING ELSE 0 END AS A_DRINKING, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_DRINKING || ',', ',' || tp.DRINKING || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_DRINKING, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_RELIGION <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_RELIGION ELSE 0 END AS A_RELIGION, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_RELIGION || ',', ',' || tp.RELIGION || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_RELIGION, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_MBTI <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_MBTI ELSE 0 END AS A_MBTI, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_MBTI || ',', ',' || tp.MBTI || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_MBTI, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_FACE_TYPE <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_FACE ELSE 0 END AS A_FACE, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_FACE_TYPE || ',', ',' || tp.FACE_TYPE || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_FACE, CASE WHEN fi.IDEAL_SKIN_TYPE <> 'ANY' THEN c.W_SKIN ELSE 0 END AS A_SKIN, CASE WHEN INSTR(',' || fi.IDEAL_SKIN_TYPE || ',', ',' || tp.SKIN_TYPE || ',') > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_SKIN, CASE WHEN NOT (fi.IDEAL_HEIGHT_MIN = 0 AND fi.IDEAL_HEIGHT_MAX = 300) THEN c.W_HEIGHT ELSE 0 END AS A_HEIGHT, CASE WHEN tp.HEIGHT BETWEEN fi.IDEAL_HEIGHT_MIN AND fi.IDEAL_HEIGHT_MAX THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_HEIGHT, CASE WHEN NOT (fi.IDEAL_WEIGHT_MIN = 0 AND fi.IDEAL_WEIGHT_MAX = 300) THEN c.W_WEIGHT ELSE 0 END AS A_WEIGHT, CASE WHEN tp.WEIGHT BETWEEN fi.IDEAL_WEIGHT_MIN AND fi.IDEAL_WEIGHT_MAX THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS H_WEIGHT FROM dir d JOIN MEMBER_IDEAL fi ON fi.MEMBER_SEQ = d.FROM_SEQ JOIN MEMBER_PROFILE tp ON tp.MEMBER_SEQ = d.TO_SEQ CROSS JOIN cfg c ), dir_score AS ( SELECT FROM_SEQ, TO_SEQ, NVL( (A_SMOKING*H_SMOKING + A_DRINKING*H_DRINKING + A_RELIGION*H_RELIGION + A_MBTI*H_MBTI + A_FACE*H_FACE + A_SKIN*H_SKIN + A_HEIGHT*H_HEIGHT + A_WEIGHT*H_WEIGHT) / NULLIF(A_SMOKING + A_DRINKING + A_RELIGION + A_MBTI + A_FACE + A_SKIN + A_HEIGHT + A_WEIGHT, 0) * 100 , 100) AS SCORE FROM item ) SELECT * FROM ( SELECT ab.TO_SEQ AS CANDIDATE_SEQ, ROUND(ab.SCORE, 2) AS SCORE_ME_TO_CAND, ROUND(ba.SCORE, 2) AS SCORE_CAND_TO_ME, ROUND(SQRT(ab.SCORE * ba.SCORE), 2) AS MUTUAL_SCORE FROM dir_score ab JOIN dir_score ba ON ba.FROM_SEQ = ab.TO_SEQ AND ba.TO_SEQ = ab.FROM_SEQ CROSS JOIN cfg c WHERE ab.FROM_SEQ = #{memberSeq} AND SQRT(ab.SCORE * ba.SCORE) >= c.MIN_SCORE ORDER BY DBMS_RANDOM.VALUE ) WHERE ROWNUM = 1
